training.reward_B_condition: all three algorithms complete A; no A model has zero physical failures, >=95% validation success AND lower mean actual cost than selected PID
training.formal_selection: eligible means >=95% passes, zero physical failures, selected checkpoint steps > 0; most passes then lowest penalized selection cost then earliest checkpoint then fixed algorithm order as exact tie break; step-zero PID fallback is not a learned success
training.primary_cost_requirement: PID and every formal seed pass every in-domain test; all corrected paired cost confidence intervals below zero
training.primary_success_requirement: every seed paired success improvement interval above zero; no additional physical failures

physical_failure: absorbing frozen state; clock and reward continue until the complete 440-step horizon
primary_comparisons: one selected algorithm per actuator; 3 fresh formal seeds; 12 intervals reserved for success/cost across two kinds
